You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0050.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np, math
rw=Chem.RWMol()
# atom symbols indexed
els=['C','O','O','C','C','O','C','O','C','C','C','C','C','C','O','C','O','C','O','O','C','C','C','C','O','O','C','C','C','C','C']
for el in els:
    rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(el))
# indices names: 0 left carbonyl,1 O,2 ester O,3 B,4 C,5 OH,6 D,7 OH,8 G,9 Me,10 E,11 F,12 Me,13 bridge CH,14 bridge O,15 alpha q,16 OH,17 carbonyl,18 O,19 ester O,20 acetal CH,21 tBu-bearing CH,22 bottom CH,23 carbonyl2,24 O,25 ester O,26 Me,27 tBu quaternary,28-30 tBu methyls
bonds=[(0,1,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(0,2,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(0,8,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
(2,3,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(3,4,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(3,6,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
(4,5,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(4,10,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(6,7,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(6,8,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
(8,9,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(10,11,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(10,12,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(10,13,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
(11,14,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(11,23,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(13,14,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(13,15,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
(13,20,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(15,16,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(15,17,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(17,18,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),
(17,19,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(19,20,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(20,21,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(21,22,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
(21,27,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(22,25,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(22,26,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
(23,24,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(23,25,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
(27,28,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(27,29,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(27,30,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)]
for i,j,b in bonds: rw.AddBond(i,j,b)
# Explicit drawn H atoms and bonds: B-H, acetal-H, bottom-H
for parent in (3,20,22):
    h=Chem.Atom('H'); hi=rw.AddAtom(h); rw.AddBond(parent,hi,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
m=rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
# All heavy atom rough 2D positions; use cartesian y inverted
xy={0:(172,479),1:(42,510),2:(228,382),3:(345,400),4:(455,354),5:(425,263),6:(357,519),7:(357,648),8:(250,570),9:(210,670),10:(534,441),11:(477,550),12:(560,483),13:(614,356),14:(652,477),15:(546,242),16:(507,185),17:(628,166),18:(594,49),19:(738,209),20:(730,324),21:(712,395),22:(593,550),23:(506,660),24:(442,756),25:(592,678),26:(593,625),27:(795,416),28:(850,370),29:(858,444),30:(795,465)}
# explicit hydrogens xyz positions
# parent 3 H dashed upper-left; 20 H dashed right; 22 H dashed lower-right
xy[31]=(310,345); xy[32]=(800,324); xy[33]=(678,600)
# 3D coords; wedges toward viewer are positive z; hashed away negative z
coords={i:np.array([x,-y,0.0]) for i,(x,y) in xy.items()}
# displaced drawn wedge atoms, including attached labels represented as atoms
for idx,z in [(5,-1.5),(7,-1.5),(9,-1.5),(14,1.5),(15,-1.5),(16,1.5),(31,-1.5),(32,-1.5),(33,-1.5),(27,-1.5)]:
    coords[idx][2]=z
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()):
    p=coords[i]
    conf.SetAtomPosition(i,tuple(float(v)/100.0 for v in p))
m.AddConformer(conf)
# Add implicit Hs and coordinate them
m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True)
# infer stereotags from constructed wedge/hashed 3D projection
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m,confId=0,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('initial smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
for a in m.GetAtoms():
    if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'):
        print('stereo',a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode'),a.GetChiralTag())
# Clear starting conformer and embed using defined chirality
m.RemoveAllConformers()
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=10500; p.maxIterations=1000; p.useSmallRingTorsions=True
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p)
print('embed',res)
if res<0:
    p.useRandomCoords=True
    res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p)
    print('retry embed',res)
if res<0: raise RuntimeError('embedding failed')
# MMFF optimization
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
if props:
    ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props)
    print('MMFF start',ff.CalcEnergy())
    ff.Minimize(maxIts=5000)
    print('MMFF final',ff.CalcEnergy())
# ensure stereo unchanged
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
    if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'):
        print('final stereo',a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode'))
# write xyz
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\n')
    f.write('3D structure generated from mol_0050.png; RDKit ETKDG/MMFF\n')
    for atom in m.GetAtoms():
        p=conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx())
        f.write(f'{atom.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .6f} {p.y: .6f} {p.z: .6f}\n')
print('atoms',m.GetNumAtoms())
